summary: WisdomTree, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of Atlantic House Holdings Limited through its wholly-owned subsidiary WisdomTree International Holdings Ltd. The all-cash purchase price was £150.0 million (approx. $200.0 million), subject to post-closing adjustments for cash, indebtedness, and working capital. The board did not disclose a recommendation or advisors in this filing. The transaction closed on May 1, 2026, per the Purchase Agreement dated March 13, 2026. No regulatory clock or structural details were provided. Watch for post-close integration updates and any earn-out or contingent consideration disclosures.
